snippet.title: PlayStation - Motto Trump Shiyouyo! i-Mode de Grand Prix (2002)

DESCRIPTION
Motto Trump Shiyouyo! i-Mode de Grand Prix is a Racing game, published by Pure Sound, which was released in Japan in 2002.
